description: Vista: remote viewing. WHEN: task Vista, the Graveyard's house viewer, with a remote-viewing run — the bot-facing door to the Remote Viewing Chamber (BETA). Give a LOCATION only: a place name or coordinates (WHERE, never WHAT — open tasking is the design; public mode holds no sealed target, so nothing can leak). Vista runs her full public protocol — mandatory cleanse + set-aside, then CRV stages I-VI on the house brain — and returns her descriptor transcript + final call for that location. She describes; she never names-and-claims, and there is NO verdict in the result: verdicts are human-only (RIGHT/WRONG on the chamber page). No key required, 0 credits, rate-limited (a session is a full AI run). Differs from the chamber web page (the human UI over the same machinery). Example: vista_remote_viewing {"location":"<location>"}

location.description: Where Vista should look — a place name (e.g. 'David's dining room, Pottsville PA') or coordinates. WHERE only, never WHAT is there.
